hypotheses.question: Does stateful orchestration preserve final T+A and deterministic causality?
hypotheses.motivation: Architecture migration must not change frozen inference
hypotheses.control: Accepted SystemPredictor/SystemSession on same model and same inputs
hypotheses.data: raw15, raw4 replay, saved1109 development inputs/outputs, synthetic fixtures
hypotheses.metrics: Exact B logits/category/probabilities; D2 probabilities/vector; context, response, availability/provenance; replay hashes; state correctness; p95 overhead and retained counts
hypotheses.effect_threshold: zero numeric/semantic differences; all tests pass; event/finalization p95<=5ms; bounded stress
hypotheses.failure_criteria: Any mismatch, leakage, unbounded retention, mandatory gate failure
hypotheses.compute: Local5080 raw15 plus fallback/replay and fixed30 warmups+200 turns per interface; CPU saved heads and stress; no fits

hypotheses.question: Do frozen T1 text prefixes provide correct useful early advisory evidence?
hypotheses.motivation: Early transcript evidence may inform later stopping research
hypotheses.candidate: 25/50/75/100 percent whitespace prefixes, unchanged previous3 human turns; singleton text-side path; no audio; final utterance labels only as imperfect diagnostic targets
hypotheses.data: Existing dev_model839 records, adaptive development; freeze IDs before any future run
hypotheses.metrics: macroF1, final agreement, entropy/margin, earliest stable label, wrong p>=0.9 fraction, p95 and total compute
hypotheses.effect_threshold: At50 percent: agreement>=0.85; macroF1 within0.05 of final; incorrect high-confidence<=0.05; p95<=25ms and total extra compute<=2x final text cost
hypotheses.failure_criteria: Any threshold fails, no reproducible causal context, future data leakage
hypotheses.compute: At most4 singleton text calls per example; zero fits
hypotheses.production_consequence: Advisory partial text only on prospective PASS; never change final response
hypotheses.decision: No optional run selected: no natural fragment timing/instantaneous labels; diagnostic agreement alone cannot justify added hot-path cost. Core delivers observation state without this computation.

hypotheses.question: Does coarse WavLM prefix recomputation yield useful acoustic estimates at acceptable cost?
hypotheses.candidate: 25/50/75/100 percent causal waveform prefixes with frozen D2, exclude prefixes shorter than400 samples
hypotheses.data: Existing allowed development raw media only; no private tuning or new corpus
hypotheses.metrics: D2 posterior divergence, stability, entropy, final agreement, permitted listener-label metric if present, p50/p95 and compute multiplier
hypotheses.effect_threshold: At50 percent: final agreement>=0.85; mean JS divergence<=0.05; total compute<=2x single final; p95 per prefix<=50ms; independent label evidence required for usefulness claim
hypotheses.failure_criteria: Missing label evidence, cost/quality gate failure or future leakage
hypotheses.compute: Up to4 full prefix executions, zero fits
hypotheses.production_consequence: Advisory prefix API only on PASS; no default response change
hypotheses.decision: Existing frozen D2 not prefix-calibrated; MELD7 labels are not CREMA6 listener truth; repeated encoder cost insufficiently justified.
